intro: Sephora sells make-up, skincare, haircare and fragrance. Its US site regularly offers free samples or gifts with a minimum spend using a code.

blocks.title: Sephora codes & offers
blocks.intro: Every offer below was checked on sephora.com. Tap a code to reveal and copy it.

sections.h2: How to use a Sephora promo code
sections.html:
1. Pick an offer above and tap Get code to reveal and copy it (deals and member perks need no code).
  2. Open sephora.com, add the items you want to your cart and check they meet the offer's terms.
  3. Paste the code into the promo or discount box at checkout and check the price drops before you pay.

• Sample-bag codes have a minimum spend; terms apply.
  • Sephora's Beauty Insider programme is free to join.

faqs.q: Is there a Sephora discount code right now?
faqs.a: Yes. As of 16 Oct 2026 we found this code on sephora.com: ALLFAVES (pick a free sample bag when you spend $55+). Codes can end without notice, so the store's checkout has the final word.

faqs.q: How does VoucherVault check Sephora codes?
faqs.a: We only list offers we have seen on Sephora's own site or app, or in its official affiliate feed, and show the date we last checked each one. Offers with a published end date disappear when it passes; offers without one are hidden if we haven't re-checked them recently.

faqs.q: Why isn't my Sephora code working?
faqs.a: The usual reasons are: the code only covers selected items, you haven't reached a minimum spend, it is for new customers or app orders only, it can't be combined with another offer, or it has just ended. Read the terms on the offer and check your basket meets them.
